title: Settings rows
description: The row registry (ADR 0027): every row of Settings in the rail's order, bands in their order. A row's id is band.row, its first part its band. Each step of the milestone-1 checklist is home on exactly one row, whose health dot shows that step's; the Set up row is home to the whole checklist. Every settings key names the row it sits on, and every step its home row. Search matches a row's id, label, hint and terms, the terms carrying the old settings addresses that open the row and the names of the sections it absorbed. A stored row id the registry does not hold opens setup.checklist.
